subtitle.en: A vocabulary mastery platform for Secondary Chinese Language
subtitle.zh: 中学华文词汇掌握平台

summary.en: 3,741 vocabulary items across G1, G2, G3 and Higher Chinese, with visible progression, streaks and student-selected challenge. Its core learning mechanics were designed around Self-Determination Theory and Assessment for Learning from the outset.
summary.zh: 3,741 个词条，涵盖 G1、G2、G3 与高级华文，具备可见的进度、连续挑战与由学生自选的难度。核心学习机制自设计之初，便以自我决定理论（SDT）与促进学习的评价（AfL）为依据。

highlight.en: Designed and built independently, in conversation with an AI coding agent (Claude Code), on a Firebase backend. The whole project was completed without a formal software-engineering background.
highlight.zh: 独立完成设计与开发，全程与 AI 编程 agent（Claude Code）协作，采用 Firebase 架构。在没有软件工程的科班背景下完成项目开发。

caption.en: Choosing scope and difficulty, never assigned. Every label carries pinyin and English.
caption.zh: 自选范围与难度，而非系统分配。每个标签同时提供拼音与英文。

summary.en: A platformer that teaches Secondary 3 G3 students to recognise argumentation techniques in two set texts. Six lives instead of three lower the cost of early mistakes, so an unfamiliar game mechanic is less likely to become the reason a student stops learning.
summary.zh: 以横向卷轴游戏教中三 G3 学生辨识两篇课文中的论证法。生命值设为六条而非三条，降低了初期失误的代价：不熟悉游戏操作，就不至于成为学生中途放弃的理由。

summary.en: Built after I asked a student what he does when he gets stuck in Chinese class. He shrugged: “stare into space?”, with an iPad already in his hands. That answer became the design brief: turn the device already on the desk into somewhere to go next. Inside are SLS lesson resources by subject level and year, past national oral exam videos by topic, reading-aloud and listening practice, graded extensive reading, and a glossary for the Singapore terms no dictionary carries. Colleagues in the department now add to it.
summary.zh: 起点是一个提问：一名学生被问到华文课上卡住时会做什么，他手里正拿着 iPad，却耸耸肩说「发呆？」。这个回答成了设计任务：让桌上那台设备，变成他下一步可以去的地方。资源站内有按科目程度与年级整理的 SLS 课程资源、按主题分类的历年全国会话考试录像、朗读与听力练习、分级泛读，以及一份字典查不到的新加坡本地词汇表。部门同事目前也陆续加入共建。
